groups.defect: Passing raw guests instead of uniqueGuests to sendAddGuestsEmails misclassifies existing attendees as newly added guests and sends them booking confirmations.
groups.rationale: All three report the same incorrect argument at the same call site; passing the persisted guest list resolves all three.

groups.defect: The team permission check uses && instead of ||, incorrectly requiring both admin and owner status.
groups.rationale: All three identify the same boolean operator and resulting denial of team-role access.

groups.defect: Guest insertion lacks server-side input deduplication, uses case-sensitive attendee and blacklist comparisons, and has a read-then-write race that permits concurrent duplicate insertions or unhandled constraint errors.
groups.rationale: s_bcca7cc3 links missing input deduplication with case-sensitive attendee checks and blacklist bypass; the narrower reports overlap those defects. s_c4f90580 shares missing input deduplication and additionally reports the concurrency race, which must survive in the unified comment.
